note: Set B binds the 18'-0" solar envelope figure correctly as an elevation and adds several well-supported, distinct facts (40 tubes in the APSE-20 arrays, powdercoated steel flatbar railing posts, tilt-and-turn door operation, tube-array spacing note, cement fibre board siding), whereas Set A repeats the same facts many times and repeatedly mislabels the 18'-0" level line as a height/dimension and the 2'-9 1/2" finished-floor level as a building height. Both sets contain an unsupported 'POWDERCOATED STEEL COLUMN' quote, and B adds two more invented 'Steel Column' claims (flat black finish, 1/8" thickness) not present in the text layer. Set A does capture the finished floor elevation, sheet title and drawing scale, which B omits, but A's misbindings and duplication are more numerous than B's errors.
